description: List the groups the current user can still join themselves (self-enrollment), with spots left and when sign-up closes. Use this when a student asks which project or lab groups are open. This tool only reads; joining happens in Brightspace under Groups > Available Groups.

courseId.description: Course ID to list joinable groups for. If omitted, checks courses that started in the last 12 months.

includeOlder.description: Without courseId, also check older and undated courses. Schools that never close a course keep years of finished courses whose sign-ups still look open.

name: get_available_groups
title: Get Available Groups
